## Exact integration blockers and owners

1. **Normal merge path — repository administrator/authorized maintainer.** Active [contributor boundary ruleset 25725675](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-applications/rules/25725675) restricts default-branch updates. The [organization policy](https://github.com/Pick-Your-AI/.github/blob/6446f03cf576cb01046fd1189efd43f7e5f02c8d/CONTRIBUTING.md) prescribes a ruleset bypass / `gh pr merge --admin`, prohibited by this campaign. No merge-denied response is claimed: no bypass or merge call was attempted. A compatible normal path is required; access/rules were not changed.
2. **Neutral author AND committer transport — repository administrator/authorized maintainer.** The working connector supports repository comments, metadata and reviews, but its commit/merge schema exposes no identity override. Prior attribution observations remain in earlier campaign evidence. Current exposed commit schemas cannot guarantee both neutral identities; no mutation was attempted to discover defaults. Missing override fields alone do not establish that a current API write would use a private address. The actual noninteractive Git push **dry-run** returned exit 128, missing HTTPS username credentials, without changing any remote ref. No secret was sought or logged. Local neutral commits and complete patches are preserved; `gh` is installed but unauthenticated; supported connector metadata/review writes remain usable.
3. **Research and exact source use — application researchers/source-use reviewers.** All category packages retain unresolved identity, comparison, territory and source/material/field/intended-use questions. A reviewed note or permissive code license does not accept a complete record, restricted assets or downstream reuse.
4. **Receiving decisions — actual affected owners.** H01/H14 gate #64/#89 scope; H09 gates #84 export/pipeline; H10 gates #86 directory. The other 16 entries remain informational at their recorded scope. Native parents require their own child acceptance. No recipient is inferred from membership/access and no assignment or message was made.
5. **Actual pilot evidence — application and affected consumer reviewers.** Real eligible records, evidence/rights decisions and actual stage/consumer receipts remain missing. Protocols and synthetic rejection fixtures are ready; no live execution is authorized by this campaign.

Review ruleset 25725543 remains active with no bypass actors: `validate` from integration 15368, non-author approval, latest-push approval and extra approval for unattributed changes remain required. Merge/squash/rebase are allowed; strict up-to-date checks are false. Current PR approval does not approve a future pushed revision or a new combined PR. Temporary write-rate limits cleared earlier; one disconnected comment response in the preceding continuation was recovered by exact readback without duplication.

**Resume commands:** reconstruct the stated base and ordered patches; run `git apply --check change.patch`, `git apply --index change.patch` and `git write-tree`. Run `python3 scripts/validate_applications.py`, `python3 scripts/validate_taxonomy.py`, `python3 scripts/validate_planning.py`, and `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`. Publish a focused contributor PR only through compliant identity transport, obtain exact-head checks/independent and formal latest-push reviews, resolve threads and use a permitted normal protected merge. Reconcile any new default change first; never force a stale patch over concurrent work. Research/receiving acceptance remains separately required.
